verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange where users can discover curated third-party and Google datasets and combine them with their internal data, accessed in place without replication. Listings can also be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace, which directly matches the marketplace-enrichment story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the consumer experience, and evidence of how broad the third-party catalog is (all evidence comes from a single intro page).
